attackers_goals: Obtain credentials used by the SCCM service.
description: Attackers or malware may use WMI queries to obtain domain credentials that are used by the SCCM.
investigative_actions: Examine the process that executed the WMI query and the CGO and verify that the processes are from a trusted source. Inspect the system for malicious activity that is related to that process.
name: Potential SCCM credential harvesting using WMI detected
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
